La réunion du 12 novembre annonce un report, mais le ticket KES-398 est plus récent. Je le lis pour trouver la nouvelle date.

The current window is **Saturday, December 5, 2026, 02:00–05:00 UTC**. Noa Friedman moved it on November 16 after the Thursday sync, and Maya Cohen approved it [2]. The migration freeze starts Thursday, December 3 [2].

For the customer notice, the ticket schedules it for Saturday, November 28, via the status page and in-app banner [2].

The Notion runbook and the #eng-announce post still show the old November 21 date, so don't use them for the notice [1][4]. The ticket says it is the reference for the window [2].

I found no support macro in the sources I searched, so you'll need to draft that from these dates.
